title: Design: AccountingHub Accounting Events shows a Held event and its reason
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have AccountingHub enabled with General Internal's row not mapped.
  • Have a customer flagged as Internal customer, with one asset, and its default internal category left at General Internal.
  • Have a closed internal work order, made for this test.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow5-04-04-accountinghub-held-event.png, iwo-happy-43-42-accountinghub-held-event.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The event shows the status Held with the reason "Internal: General Internal row not mapped" and the Retry action.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11765 (Story 8, AccountingHub, the closed work order and its parts cost)

  • S8-N2: “If a mapped account on either side of the entry is missing or inactive, or the posting date falls in a closed fiscal period or in none, the event gets a status Held (new in the hub) on the Accounting Events page with the reason ("No Charge: [Category] row not mapped" or "Internal: [Category] row not mapped", the list name telling the two apart (S8-R7), "Shop supplies expense is not mapped", "Inventory asset is not mapped", "Parts cost of goods sold is not mapped", "Period [name] is closed", or the hub's existing "No open fiscal period covers [date]."), the existing Retry action, and automatic retry when the mapping is saved or the period opened. Other events for the organization keep flowing. A held Close withdrawn by Reopen becomes Dismissed (S4-E1). Held exists for these work-order entries only (Close, reversal, no-charge line, and the move of a vendor bill or credit line to its category account, S8-R3); invoices, vendor bills, credits and payments keep today's statuses.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794484794-2031, read and rendered 12 Nov 2026: pages "Flow 5 · What the books see" / "Happy flow v6", boards "04 AccountingHub · Held event" (Flow 5 · What the books see), "42 AccountingHub · Held event" (Happy flow v6).

  • iwo-happy-43-42-accountinghub-held-event.png
